title: SRVO-062: BZAL alarm: pulsecoder backup battery voltage zero, absolute position lost
symptom: At 07:15 Blank Handling Robot 2 went down with SRVO-062. Operator tried reset twice, alarm returned.
diagnosis: On site 07:30. Followed troubleshooting steps in the FANUC M-900iB/360 manual for SRVO-062. Measured battery_voltage_v = 3.16 V (nominal 3.6, warn 3.1, alarm 2.6). Found: battery cable disconnected or broken inside base.
action_taken: 1) Replaced robot base and controller batteries (A02B-0200-K102 lithium). 2) Cleared alarm with RES_PCA from the pulsecoder screen and cycle power. 3) Re-mastered the affected axes (zero-position or quick mastering) and verify against witness marks. 4) Validated TCP and run the weld/path accuracy check before returning to production.
root_cause: Battery cable disconnected or broken inside base
narrative: Machine returned to production, monitor closely. Total downtime 121 min.

title: SRVO-062: BZAL alarm: pulsecoder backup battery voltage zero, absolute position lost
symptom: SRVO-062 displayed on HMI; Battery module stacker stopped mid-cycle. Andon pulled at 10:24.
diagnosis: Initial check 10:34, Battery module stacker fault SRVO-062 confirmed. Measured battery_voltage_v = 3.19 V (nominal 3.6, warn 3.1, alarm 2.6). Probable cause encoder backup battery fully discharged.
action_taken: Replaced robot base and controller batteries (A02B-0200-K102 lithium). Cleared alarm with RES_PCA from the pulsecoder screen and cycle power. Re-mastered the affected axes (zero-position or quick mastering) and verify against witness marks. Validated TCP and run the weld/path accuracy check before returning to production.
narrative: Spare ordered; temporary fix in place. Total downtime 219 min.

title: AGV-DRIVE-WHEEL: Drive wheel wear / motor overload
symptom: At 12:50 Autonomous Mobile Robot 3 went down with AGV-DRIVE-WHEEL. Operator tried reset twice, alarm returned.
diagnosis: Initial check 13:03, Autonomous Mobile Robot 3 fault AGV-DRIVE-WHEEL confirmed. Measured motor_current_a = 19.32 A (nominal 12, warn 22, alarm 28). Probable cause bearing wear.
action_taken: Replaced drive wheel assembly.
narrative: Machine returned to production, monitor closely. Total downtime 63 min.

title: LSR-CHL-TEMP: Chiller outlet temperature out of range
symptom: Intermittent LSR-CHL-TEMP over last hour, now hard-stopped. Operator noted nothing unusual before the stop.
diagnosis: On site 16:05. Followed troubleshooting steps in the TRUMPF TruDisk 8001 busbar cell manual for LSR-CHL-TEMP. Measured coolant_temp_c = 26.36 C (nominal 22, warn 27, alarm 31). Found: chiller refrigerant low.
action_taken: 1) Checked chiller setpoint/flow. 2) Cleaned condenser.
narrative: Follow-up inspection requested next PM window. Total downtime 92 min. Repeat failure within 14 days of WO-2024-000020.

narrative: Spare ordered; temporary fix in place. Total downtime 33 min.

title: CNV-JAM: Carrier jam / zone blocked
symptom: CNV-JAM displayed on HMI; Hairpin Stator Winding Cell 1 stopped mid-cycle. Andon pulled at 07:27.
diagnosis: On site 07:39. Followed troubleshooting steps in the Aumann Hairpin winding line manual for CNV-JAM. Found: misaligned carrier.

narrative: Handed over to next shift for monitoring. Total downtime 229 min.

title: AGV-LIDAR: Safety laser scanner fault / dirty
symptom: At 16:02 Decking (Marriage) AGV 2 went down with AGV-LIDAR. Operator tried reset twice, alarm returned.

title: TST-COMM: Test station communication loss to MES
symptom: TST-COMM displayed on HMI; Adhesive Dispensing Station 1 stopped at part pickup. Andon pulled at 16:20.
diagnosis: On site 16:30. Followed troubleshooting steps in the Duerr EcoShot manual for TST-COMM. Found: network switch port.
action_taken: 1) Restarted service; replace patch cable/switch port.
narrative: Tested 5 good cycles before release. Total downtime 11 min. Repeat failure within 14 days of WO-2025-003519.

title: OVN-CHAIN: Conveyor chain drive fault in oven
symptom: At 20:45 Cure Oven 1 went down with OVN-CHAIN. Operator tried reset twice, alarm returned.
diagnosis: Arrived 20:47. Checked chain tension hot. Cause: thermal expansion.
action_taken: Checked chain tension hot.
narrative: Root cause confirmed; permanent fix complete. Total downtime 175 min.

title: TQ-NOK: Tightening result NOK: torque out of window
symptom: Operator reports: tightening result NOK: torque out of window. Machine halted in cycle, alarm TQ-NOK.
diagnosis: On site 23:55. Followed troubleshooting steps in the Atlas Copco Power Focus 6000 + Tensor ST manual for TQ-NOK. Measured torque_nm = 49.17 Nm (nominal 55.0, warn 50.0, alarm 46.0). Found: cross-threaded fastener.
action_taken: 1) Inspected joint; do NOT re-tighten without quality approval. 2) Ran calibration check on the tool. 3) Replaced socket if worn.
narrative: Tested 5 good cycles before release. Total downtime 20 min.

diagnosis: Initial check 11:06, 5-Axis Machining Center 3 fault CNC-PART-OOT confirmed. Probable cause thermal growth.

narrative: Handed over to next shift for monitoring. Total downtime 36 min.

title: AGV-BAT-LOW: Battery SoC low / charging contact failure
symptom: Decking (Marriage) AGV 1 faulted (AGV-BAT-LOW). Line lead called maintenance via radio at 12:20.
diagnosis: On site 12:26. Followed troubleshooting steps in the KUKA Omnimove heavy-load AGV manual for AGV-BAT-LOW. Measured battery_soc_pct = 20.63 % (nominal 70, warn 25, alarm 15). Found: charge contact wear.
action_taken: 1) Clean/replace charge contacts.
narrative: Follow-up inspection requested next PM window. Total downtime 23 min.

title: TST-HV-ISO: Insulation resistance fault on HV test circuit
symptom: TST-HV-ISO displayed on HMI; Thermal Interface Dispenser 1 stopped after restart from break. Andon pulled at 14:34.
diagnosis: On site 14:46. Followed troubleshooting steps in the Nordson Two-component gap-filler dispense manual for TST-HV-ISO. Found: moisture ingress.
action_taken: 1) De-energized per HV procedure; inspect cables; megger test.
narrative: Spare ordered; temporary fix in place. Total downtime 79 min.

title: SRVO-050: Collision detect alarm
symptom: Intermittent SRVO-050 over last hour, now hard-stopped. Operator noted a small puddle near the base.
diagnosis: Arrived 15:53. Backed the robot out in T1 using the collision release. Measured motor_current_a = 24.08 A (nominal 18.0, warn 26.0, alarm 32.0). Cause: part or fixture misplaced in the cell.

root_cause: Part or fixture misplaced in the cell
narrative: Follow-up inspection requested next PM window. Total downtime 95 min.

title: CNV-ENC-LOSS: Position encoder lost sync

title: TQ-NOK: Tightening result NOK: torque out of window
symptom: TQ-NOK displayed on HMI; Pack Fastening Station 3 stopped at cycle end. Andon pulled at 16:22.
diagnosis: Initial check 16:32, Pack Fastening Station 3 fault TQ-NOK confirmed. Measured torque_nm = 16.66 Nm (nominal 18.0, warn 16.5, alarm 15.0). Probable cause joint friction variation (bolt batch).
action_taken: Inspected joint; do NOT re-tighten without quality approval. Ran calibration check on the tool. Replaced socket if worn. Quarantine suspect fastener lot if repeating.
narrative: Handed over to next shift for monitoring. Total downtime 11 min.

diagnosis: Arrived 18:13. Checked mechanical free movement. Measured motor_current_a = 41.06 A (nominal 30, warn 45, alarm 55). Cause: motor winding degradation.
action_taken: Checked mechanical free movement.

title: KSS-MAINT-OIL: Maintenance reminder: gear oil change due (A1-A3)
symptom: Operator reports: maintenance reminder: gear oil change due (A1-A3). Machine halted in cycle, alarm KSS-MAINT-OIL.
diagnosis: Arrived 01:09. Scheduled gear oil change using the OEM-approved synthetic ISO VG 150 oil (e.g. Shell Tivela S150 in QUANTEC axes). Measured gearbox_temp_c = 71.78 C (nominal 48.0, warn 70.0, alarm 82.0). Cause: operating hours reached service interval (10,000-20,000 h or 3-4 years depending on model).
action_taken: Performed oil change with robot warm but not hot, drain per OEM procedure.
root_cause: Operating hours reached service interval (10,000-20,000 h or 3-4 years depending on model)
narrative: Root cause confirmed; permanent fix complete. Total downtime 135 min.

title: WG-TIP-WEAR: Electrode tip wear over limit / weld quality alert
symptom: WG-TIP-WEAR displayed on HMI; Spot Weld Robot (KUKA) 3 stopped at cycle end. Andon pulled at 07:13.
diagnosis: On site 07:25. Followed troubleshooting steps in the KUKA KR 210 R2700 prime manual for WG-TIP-WEAR. Measured weld_current_ka = 8.12 kA (nominal 9.0, warn 7.8, alarm 7.0). Found: tip dress count exceeded.
action_taken: 1) Performed tip dress or change.
narrative: Spare ordered; temporary fix in place. Total downtime 21 min.

title: DOS-TC-DRIFT: Melt thermocouple drift / over-temperature
symptom: DOS-TC-DRIFT displayed on HMI; Dosing Furnace 2 stopped at part pickup. Andon pulled at 08:03.
diagnosis: Arrived 08:16. Replaced thermocouple; verify with immersion probe. Measured melt_temp_c = 727.92 C (nominal 700, warn 725, alarm 740). Cause: thermocouple sheath degraded.
action_taken: Replaced thermocouple; verify with immersion probe.
narrative: Spare ordered; temporary fix in place. Total downtime 69 min. Repeat failure within 14 days of WO-2025-008520.

title: TQ-MOTOR-TEMP: Tool motor temperature high
symptom: Operator reports: tool motor temperature high. Machine halted in cycle, alarm TQ-MOTOR-TEMP.
diagnosis: On site 08:37. Followed troubleshooting steps in the Atlas Copco Power Focus 6000 + Tensor ST manual for TQ-MOTOR-TEMP. Measured motor_temp_c = 63.62 C (nominal 38, warn 62, alarm 75). Found: gear head worn.
action_taken: 1) Allowed cooldown; check gear head grease. 2) Replaced gear head.
narrative: Handed over to next shift for monitoring. Total downtime 58 min. Repeat failure within 14 days of WO-2025-008556.

title: AGV-NAV-LOST: Localization lost
symptom: AGV-NAV-LOST displayed on HMI; Decking (Marriage) AGV 1 stopped mid-cycle. Andon pulled at 08:44.
diagnosis: Arrived 08:48. Re-localize; update map layout. Cause: environment changed.
action_taken: Inspected drive wheels.
narrative: Spare ordered; temporary fix in place. Total downtime 19 min. Repeat failure within 14 days of WO-2025-008727.

title: PRS-FILTER-DP: Filter differential pressure high
symptom: At 10:33 Servo Press 2 went down with PRS-FILTER-DP. Operator tried reset twice, alarm returned.
diagnosis: On site 10:38. Followed troubleshooting steps in the Schuler MSP 2000 servo press manual for PRS-FILTER-DP. Found: filter loaded with particles.
action_taken: 1) Replaced pressure and return filters. 2) Sampled oil for particle count (ISO 4406).
narrative: Tested 5 good cycles before release. Total downtime 21 min.

title: LSR-PWR-LOW: Laser output power below tolerance (measured vs. commanded)
symptom: Laser Brazing Cell 2 faulted (LSR-PWR-LOW). Line lead called maintenance via radio at 11:54.
diagnosis: Arrived 12:04. Inspect/replace protective glass. Measured laser_power_pct = 95.06 % (nominal 100, warn 94, alarm 90). Cause: protective glass contaminated.
action_taken: Inspect/replace protective glass.
narrative: Root cause confirmed; permanent fix complete. Total downtime 95 min. Repeat failure within 14 days of WO-2025-008404.

title: CNV-DRV-OVL: Drive overload (VFD)

title: SRVO-050: Collision detect alarm
symptom: SRVO-050 displayed on HMI; Cell Stacking Robot 3 stopped during start-up. Andon pulled at 08:59.
diagnosis: Arrived 09:07. Backed the robot out in T1 using the collision release. Measured motor_current_a = 25.93 A (nominal 18.0, warn 26.0, alarm 32.0). Cause: part or fixture misplaced in the cell.
action_taken: Inspected tooling, gun and fixture for damage; Verified payload/armload settings; Checked J2/J3 reducer for abnormal noise and disturbance torque.
root_cause: Part or fixture misplaced in the cell
narrative: Follow-up inspection requested next PM window. Total downtime 59 min.

action_taken: 1) Inspected damper actuator. 2) Cleaned exhaust duct.
narrative: Root cause confirmed; permanent fix complete. Total downtime 63 min.

title: SRVO-065: BLAL alarm: pulsecoder battery voltage low (data still intact)
symptom: Press transfer robot faulted (SRVO-065). Line lead called maintenance via radio at 18:19.
diagnosis: On site 18:34. Followed troubleshooting steps in the FANUC M-900iB/360 manual for SRVO-065. Measured battery_voltage_v = 3.20 V (nominal 3.6, warn 3.1, alarm 2.6). Found: missed preventive battery replacement.

title: TQ-NOK: Tightening result NOK: torque out of window
symptom: Torque Station 8 faulted (TQ-NOK). Line lead called maintenance via radio at 19:59.
diagnosis: On site 20:10. Followed troubleshooting steps in the Atlas Copco Power Focus 6000 + Tensor ST manual for TQ-NOK. Measured torque_nm = 50.92 Nm (nominal 55.0, warn 50.0, alarm 46.0). Found: cross-threaded fastener.
action_taken: 1) Inspected joint; do NOT re-tighten without quality approval. 2) Ran calibration check on the tool. 3) Replaced socket if worn.
narrative: Tested 5 good cycles before release. Total downtime 40 min.

title: TQ-NOK: Tightening result NOK: torque out of window
symptom: TQ-NOK displayed on HMI; Pack Fastening Station 4 stopped mid-cycle. Andon pulled at 21:32.
diagnosis: On site 21:35. Followed troubleshooting steps in the Desoutter 4-spindle synchronous fastening (20 Nm) manual for TQ-NOK. Measured torque_nm = 16.91 Nm (nominal 18.0, warn 16.5, alarm 15.0). Found: tool transducer drift.
action_taken: 1) Inspected joint; do NOT re-tighten without quality approval. 2) Ran calibration check on the tool. 3) Replaced socket if worn. 4) Quarantine suspect fastener lot if repeating.
narrative: Handed over to next shift for monitoring. Total downtime 21 min.

title: TQ-CBL-FAULT: Tool cable / communication fault
symptom: Operator reports: tool cable / communication fault. Machine halted in cycle, alarm TQ-CBL-FAULT.
diagnosis: Arrived 11:30. Replaced tool cable; verify controller link. Cause: flex fatigue in tool cable.
action_taken: Replaced tool cable; verify controller link.
narrative: Root cause confirmed; permanent fix complete. Total downtime 31 min.

title: WG-TIP-WEAR: Electrode tip wear over limit / weld quality alert
symptom: Intermittent WG-TIP-WEAR over last hour, now hard-stopped. Operator noted slower cycle than usual over the shift.
diagnosis: Arrived 11:53. Performed tip dress or change. Measured weld_current_ka = 8.02 kA (nominal 9.0, warn 7.8, alarm 7.0). Cause: tip dress count exceeded.
action_taken: Verified cooling flow; Ran weld nugget peel test.
narrative: Root cause confirmed; permanent fix complete. Total downtime 16 min.

title: LSR-SHUTTER: Safety shutter did not confirm open
symptom: Intermittent LSR-SHUTTER over last hour, now hard-stopped. Operator noted slower cycle than usual over the shift.
diagnosis: On site 02:32. Followed troubleshooting steps in the TRUMPF TruDisk 8001 busbar cell manual for LSR-SHUTTER. Found: cable fault.
action_taken: 1) Checked shutter position sensor. 2) Replaced cable.
narrative: Spare ordered; temporary fix in place. Total downtime 32 min.

title: TST-COMM: Test station communication loss to MES
symptom: Intermittent TST-COMM over last hour, now hard-stopped. Operator noted a small puddle near the base.
diagnosis: On site 04:17. Followed troubleshooting steps in the AVL E-drive NVH end-of-line bench manual for TST-COMM. Found: service crash.
action_taken: 1) Restarted service; replace patch cable/switch port.
narrative: Follow-up inspection requested next PM window. Total downtime 14 min.

title: TQ-NOK: Tightening result NOK: torque out of window
symptom: Operator reports: tightening result NOK: torque out of window. Machine halted in cycle, alarm TQ-NOK.
diagnosis: Arrived 04:17. Inspected joint; do NOT re-tighten without quality approval. Measured torque_nm = 16.73 Nm (nominal 18.0, warn 16.5, alarm 15.0). Cause: tool transducer drift.
action_taken: Ran calibration check on the tool; Replaced socket if worn.
narrative: Follow-up inspection requested next PM window. Total downtime 11 min. Repeat failure within 14 days of WO-2026-002878.

title: PRS-TEMP-HIGH: Hydraulic oil temperature high

diagnosis: Initial check 04:23, Servo Press 2 fault PRS-TEMP-HIGH confirmed. Measured hyd_temp_c = 57.46 C (nominal 43, warn 56, alarm 63). Probable cause cooler fouled.
action_taken: Cleaned oil cooler, verify water flow. Checked thermostat valve.
narrative: Tested 5 good cycles before release. Total downtime 79 min.

title: LSR-CHL-TEMP: Chiller outlet temperature out of range
symptom: LSR-CHL-TEMP displayed on HMI; Busbar Laser Welder 1 stopped at cycle end. Andon pulled at 18:49.
diagnosis: On site 18:54. Followed troubleshooting steps in the TRUMPF TruDisk 8001 busbar cell manual for LSR-CHL-TEMP. Measured coolant_temp_c = 25.86 C (nominal 22, warn 27, alarm 31). Found: chiller refrigerant low.
action_taken: 1) Checked chiller setpoint/flow. 2) Cleaned condenser.
narrative: Handed over to next shift for monitoring. Total downtime 113 min.

title: LSR-PWR-LOW: Laser output power below tolerance (measured vs. commanded)
symptom: Busbar Laser Welder 1 faulted (LSR-PWR-LOW). Line lead called maintenance via radio at 21:53.
diagnosis: On site 22:02. Followed troubleshooting steps in the TRUMPF TruDisk 8001 busbar cell manual for LSR-PWR-LOW. Measured laser_power_pct = 93.69 % (nominal 100, warn 94, alarm 90). Found: protective glass contaminated.
action_taken: 1) Inspect/replace protective glass.
narrative: Tested 5 good cycles before release. Total downtime 168 min. Repeat failure within 14 days of WO-2026-005123.

title: TQ-MOTOR-TEMP: Tool motor temperature high
symptom: Torque Station 2 faulted (TQ-MOTOR-TEMP). Line lead called maintenance via radio at 22:14.
diagnosis: Initial check 22:28, Torque Station 2 fault TQ-MOTOR-TEMP confirmed. Measured motor_temp_c = 66.16 C (nominal 38, warn 62, alarm 75). Probable cause duty cycle too high.
action_taken: Allowed cooldown; check gear head grease. Replaced gear head.
narrative: Tested 5 good cycles before release. Total downtime 92 min.

title: LSR-CHL-TEMP: Chiller outlet temperature out of range

title: PRS-TEMP-HIGH: Hydraulic oil temperature high

title: SRVO-050: Collision detect alarm

title: GP-TEMP-HIGH: Hydraulic oil temperature high
symptom: At 09:21 Giga Press 1 went down with GP-TEMP-HIGH. Operator tried reset twice, alarm returned.
diagnosis: On site 09:34. Followed troubleshooting steps in the IDRA GIGAPRESS NEO 6100 manual for GP-TEMP-HIGH. Measured hyd_temp_c = 60.19 C (nominal 46, warn 58, alarm 65). Found: cooler fouled.
action_taken: 1) Cleaned oil cooler, verify water flow. 2) Checked thermostat valve. 3) Trended temperature vs. cycle count.
narrative: Spare ordered; temporary fix in place. Total downtime 113 min.

title: KSS-MAINT-OIL: Maintenance reminder: gear oil change due (A1-A3)
symptom: At 11:53 Glazing Robot 1 went down with KSS-MAINT-OIL. Operator tried reset twice, alarm returned.
diagnosis: On site 12:00. Followed troubleshooting steps in the KUKA KR 150 R3100 glazing manual for KSS-MAINT-OIL. Measured gearbox_temp_c = 67.59 C (nominal 48.0, warn 70.0, alarm 82.0). Found: operating hours reached service interval (10,000-20,000 h or 3-4 years depending on model).
action_taken: 1) Scheduled gear oil change using the OEM-approved synthetic ISO VG 150 oil (e.g. Shell Tivela S150 in QUANTEC axes).
root_cause: Operating hours reached service interval (10,000-20,000 h or 3-4 years depending on model)
